name: When should I consider remodeling my luxury home instead of buying a new one?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider remodeling my luxury home instead of buying a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider remodeling if your current home's location, lot, or foundational structure is ideal, but the interior or exterior no longer meets your aesthetic or functional needs. Remodeling allows you to customize every detail to your precise preferences and lifestyle, often adding significant value while avoiding the stress and costs associated with moving. It's an excellent option for those who cherish their current neighborhood or have sentimental attachment to their property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel when you love your current location and structure, but need updated aesthetics or functionality, allowing for full customization and added value.
